dedupe_keys.name: walking and bicycling travel time matrix for helsinki metropolitan area metro and train stations

description: Walking and bicycling travel time matrix for Helsinki Metropolitan Area metro and train stations is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Helsingin seudun ympäristöpalvelut (HSY). Huvudstadsregionens tåg- och metrostationers dillgänglighet i tid genom att gå och cykla längs lätta trafikleder. Tillgänglighetszonerna har beräknats för tidsperioder på 5, 10 och 15 min. Beräkningen har inletts vid ingången till stationerna/perrongerna. Gånghastigheten har fastställts som 5.2 km/h och cykelhastigheten som 14 km/h. Materialen kan ses och laddas ner i HRM:s öppna karttjänst. Coverage: Helsingin seudun ympäristöpalvelut (HSY). The portal shows the English title as "Walking and cycling time zones for metropolitan stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Helsingin seudun ympäristöpalvelut (HSY). Its keywords include promenad, cycling, walking, stations, asemat, liikenne. The listing shows 6 download or service links in SHP, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
